title: Reducing the Risk of Transplant Rejection: Simultaneous Kidney and Bone Marrow Transplant
brief_summary: This study will examine the safety and effectiveness of a combination kidney and bone marrow transplant from a relative with the same (or nearly the same) blood cell type as the transplant recipient. An investigational medication will be given prior to and after the transplant to help protect the transplanted kidney from attack by the body's immune system.
